data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (at 1 Jan 2019) was $766.5m (prior-year balance). During 2019 the syndicate reported a small net prioryear release of $3.7m driven by favourable claims development in specialty lines and cyber offset by adverse movements in reinsurance and property (including some catastrophe-related loss creep on earlier events). The 2019 underwriting year itself was impacted by Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan and management continue to monitor reserve adequacy through regular peer review and actuarial analysis.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, 2018 comparative). Prior year movement ($3.7m) is reported in the strategic report as a prior year reserve release but appears to be a NET figure (after reinsurance); no explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was found in the notes. LOB reserve movement amounts in the report's prior-year releases table are net figures (after reinsurance). All monetary values reported are in the report's native currency (USD). The detailed gross claims development triangle is present in the technical provisions note, but a granular gross PYD (Insurance liabilities column) explicit total was not clearly provided; therefore a net PYD number is reported and flagged as net in this summary.
